purpose: Wire ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 into the phoneremote daemon spawn and verify the remote daemon starts through the product code and from the app.

envChange.behavior: adds ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 when absent (case-insensitive key check), preserves an explicit value, copies the parent environment verbatim; plain Node ignores the variable (verified: runtime/node prints it and still runs at ABI 137)
envChange.secrets: no logging: daemonEnv emits nothing and the child scope discards stderr (io.Discard)

spawnPathProof.what: phoneremote.ResolveResources/Start with NO ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE in the shell (tmp/probe-remote-live, os.Unsetenv before Start)

appRun.exe: whaleisle-remote-app.exe (temp build from ./cmd/whaleisle with the env fix; deleted after the run)
appRun.profile: throwaway profile (tmp/remote-app-profile-*), config remoteEnabled=true, remoteMode=lan, remotePort=3499, remoteBindAddress=127.0.0.1, remoteLanTls=false, harness port 3099, temp workspace, welcome-shown marker, real runtime/vendor

attempt1.result: launcher error: "vendored harness not found; set WHALEISLE_VENDOR or run scripts/build-harness.ps1" (paths.VendorDir resolves next to the exe first; a temp build must live beside runtime/)

attempt2.result: app starts; harness listener 127.0.0.1:3099 up from the staged runtime (node child runtime/vendor/deepseek-harness/apps/cli/lib/bin.js)
attempt2.launcherTransition: launcher 1060x660 -> main 1440x920 observed within ~15-20 s after the harness came up
attempt2.settings: relaunched with --settings; settings nav exposed 远程; remote panel rendered (网关 tab: 连接方式 局域网/服务器, 监听端口, 监听范围, 传输加密, 刷新)
attempt2.uiActions: clicked 局域网 (ok) and 刷新 (ok); panel then showed "refresh the phone runtime before managing devices"; no 3499/3180 listener appeared and no dshd-remote node child was spawned

finding.summary: remoteEnabled=true in config does not start the phone gateway at boot; refreshPhoneRemote is only invoked from UI actions, so the in-app daemon never started.
finding.evidence: cmd/whaleisle/main.go:763 (definition) with call sites only at main.go:5134, main.go:5141, main.go:5225 (QR refresh), main.go:5281 and cmd/whaleisle/phone_gateway.go:49; no startup/Ready hook.
finding.nextFix: after harness Ready (or at startup when cfg.RemoteEnabled), call refreshPhoneRemote once; then the spawn env fix makes the daemon start from the app.

residual: in-app remote daemon start is blocked by the missing boot-time refreshPhoneRemote (cmd change, outside this task scope)
relay mode, 0.0.0.0 bind and real-phone pairing remain unverified
packaging still uses scripts/build-mobile-runtime.ps1 (online) for a truthful mobile runtime; the asar staging stays gitignored under runtime/
the temp build must be placed beside runtime/ (repo root) or WHALEISLE_VENDOR must be set
